sentences.text: The CRETA offers an 8-speaker Bose premium sound system with a front central speaker and sub-woofer on selected higher trims like SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.
Depending on the variant, it pairs with either an 8.0-inch touchscreen or a 10.25-inch navigation display, while the base E trim does not include a standard touchscreen.
